quality.H_hard: No material wrong fact, date/currency/program comparison, identity/role mismatch, invented connection/protection/bookability/party total, or unsupported necessary/best/only tradeoff disproved by eligible evidence. Unknown quote scope does not erase traveler support.
quality.U_hard: A defensible exact recommendation with reason and downside, or truthful no-complete-result outcome with relevant lead/coverage limitation. Connected explanation, brief supported cash context and applicable limitations; exact references for evaluated choices/alternatives.
quality.C_graded: insufficient/basic/decision-rich; record lost dimensions separately. Aim decision-rich; no fixed cabin/style/count quota, exhaustive frontier or optimal representative requirement. Omission is H failure only when it makes the asserted central argument false/misleading. Basic feasibility does not silently qualify old M2 acceptance.
quality.protocol: clean/annotated/unrecoverable separate from semantic correctness. New wire intentionally omits optional declared-claim annotations; decoder expands claims empty, which is not stronger factual checking. Distinct multiple benchmarks is explicit invalid-wire generation failure; repeated highlight/alternative never deselects an existing highlight. No silent source repair.
quality.review: Freeze source-grounded challenges/rubric before confirmation. Review anonymized answer/source bundles without arm, tier, effort, latency, usage or desired winner; every correctness failure quotes a sentence and exact source counterexample. Preserve disagreements and all unavailable/annotated outcomes. Old campaign judgments are not relabeled as new success.

coverage_claims: Prospective development H/U/coverage evaluation and under20target, not owner presentation acceptance, M3 qualification, holdout/general reliability or deployment. Runtime implementation and replay get separate verification receipts.
pricing_basis: Use recorded standard Luna rates from prior evidence, Fast2x applicable rates per official Luna docs; report actual usage/cache and estimate limits; no count billing/native Codex invoice claim.
